name: KAIST feeder
full_name: KAIST two-DOF buckling-prevention feeder for robotic catheterization
group: KAIST, Department of Mechanical Engineering / Robotics Program (Dong-Soo Kwon; Hyunwoo Baek, Byungsik Cheon, Jae Min You)
rotation_detail: second driving-shaft module rotates the roller module (two motors total)
force_sensing: none on the catheter (testbed load cells for evaluation)
sterility: disposable roller module; draped attachment to the robot (Fig. 14)
validation_detail: bench testbeds and a robot-system buckling test; phantom testing stated as future work (baek2022_design)
key_numbers: rollers 20 mm, spacing 22.5 mm, grip force 5.90 N; feeder max 4.01 N / 6.74 mNm at 3 mm/s (requirement 4.5 N / 8 mNm); translation RMSE 1.68 mm (max 3.05 mm), rotation RMSE 1.23 deg; insertion ratio 0.992 (baek2022_design, OUP HTML)
